ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the upper left of the figure there is a substituent labeled R, connected to a section of carbon chain; this carbon chain continues to the right/down and connects to an oxygen atom labeled O. The oxygen atom then connects to the central carbon atom at the lower right. The central carbon atom is connected by a double bond to the sulfur atom labeled S at the lower left, and is connected to another S at the lower right; this lower-right S continues to connect to a terminal short line, indicating a methyl group. The curved arrows in the figure only indicate electron flow, and the problem requires ignoring them. Then reason: according to the specified method, take R as the wildcard atom *, and from R along the continuous skeleton obtain *-C-C-O-. Oxygen is connected to the thiocarbonyl carbon, this central carbon is written as C(=S), and it is also single-bonded to S-methyl, namely -SC. Therefore the overall SMILES is *CCOC(=S)SC.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First visually identify only the atom connectivity, disregarding electron-flow arrows. Treat the labeled R group as a wildcard atom `*`. Trace the continuous skeleton from R through the two-carbon fragment to oxygen, then to the central thiocarbonyl carbon. Encode the central carbon as bonded to O, double-bonded to S, and single-bonded to an S-methyl substituent. This gives the SMILES `*CCOC(=S)SC`.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左上方有一个标记为 R 的取代基，连接到一段碳链；该碳链继续向右/下连接到标记为 O 的氧原子。氧原子再连接到右下方的中心碳原子。中心碳原子与左下方标记为 S 的硫原子以双键形式相连，并与右下方另一个 S 相连；该右下方 S 继续连接到一条末端短线，表示甲基。图中的弯箭头只表示电子流，题目要求忽略。再推理：按指定方法将 R 作为通配原子 *，从 R 沿连续骨架得到 *-C-C-O-。氧连接到硫代羰基碳，该中心碳写作 C(=S)，并且还单键连接 S-甲基，即 -SC。因此整体 SMILES 为 *CCOC(=S)SC。
